chain.label: IMC with low ceiling/visibility at departure and en route
chain.trigger: Instrument meteorological conditions (IMC) prevailed at the time of the accident

chain.label: Complete loss of a.c. electrical power in flight
chain.trigger: the physical evidence recovered from the wreckage site and the recorded radar data indicate that a complete loss of a.c. electrical power occurred aboard the airplane

chain.label: Loss of most pilot-side flight instruments and autopilot
chain.trigger: The complete loss of a.c. electrical power would have rendered most of the pilot's flight instruments inoperative

caused_by.evidence: would have rendered most of the pilot's flight instruments inoperative

chain.label: Pilot mismanaged workload of troubleshooting vs. flying the airplane
chain.trigger: the pilot did not appropriately manage the workload associated with troubleshooting the loss of a.c. electrical power with the need to establish and maintain positive control of the airplane

caused_by.evidence: troubleshooting the loss of a.c. electrical power

chain.label: Pilot became spatially disoriented
chain.trigger: the pilot's spatial disorientation resulting from his failure to maintain positive manual control of the airplane with the available flight instrumentation

caused_by.evidence: spatial disorientation resulting from his failure to maintain positive manual control of the airplane
spatial disorientation can only be prevented by visual reference to reliable fixed points on the ground or to flight instruments

chain.label: Airplane entered an unrecognized descending spiral (graveyard spiral)
chain.trigger: the airplane's estimated flightpath in the final 2 minutes of flight was consistent with a graveyard spiral resulting from pilot spatial disorientation

caused_by.evidence: graveyard spiral resulting from pilot spatial disorientation

chain.label: Pilot made a severe pull-up to arrest the dive
chain.trigger: The pilot likely initiated a severe pull-up maneuver by pulling back on the control column

caused_by.evidence: the pilot attempted to arrest the descent in the final portion of the flight

chain.label: Aerodynamic loading overloaded the horizontal stabilizer and wing
chain.trigger: the aerodynamic loading during the pilot's pull-up maneuver was great enough to overload the horizontal stabilizer downward and the right outboard wing section was sufficiently loaded upward to sustain a permanent bend

caused_by.evidence: aerodynamic loading during the pilot's pull-up maneuver was great enough to overload

chain.label: Tail and outboard wing separated in flight
chain.trigger: the in-flight breakup occurred because the aerodynamic loading during the pilot's pull-up maneuver was great enough to overload the horizontal stabilizer

caused_by.evidence: in-flight breakup occurred because the aerodynamic loading...was great enough to overload

chain.label: Airplane impacted rolling terrain
chain.trigger: the airplane impacted rolling terrain at an elevation of 5,223 feet

caused_by.evidence: scattered debris found at the accident site were also consistent with an in-flight breakup at a low altitude

chain.label: All 10 occupants killed
chain.trigger: All 10 occupants aboard N81PF were killed

caused_by.evidence: subjected to impact forces that exceeded the limits of human tolerance
